title: Jury in Palisades Fire Trial Finds Man Guilty of Arson in Devastating Blaze
summary: The defendant, Jonathan Rinderknecht, was found guilty on two counts. The verdict provides a measure of accountability for a painful chapter in recent L.A. history.
